facts.business: Updater Services Limited is one of India's leading integrated business services platforms, delivering a comprehensive range of facility management and business support services through a strong pan-India presence.
facts.related_party_note: Entities under Common Control: Best Security Services Private Limited, Tangi Facility Solutions Private Limited, Tangirala Infrastructure Development Private Limited, Updater Services Private Limited - Employees Group Gratuity Scheme. Key Management Personnel: Mr. Raghunandana Tangirala (Managing Director), Mrs. Sandhya Saravanan (Company Secretary), Mrs. Radha Ramanujan (CFO until Sep 04, 2025), Mr. Surinder Kumar (CFO until Mar 16, 2026), Mr. Ram Praveen (CFO w.e.f Mar 16, 2026), Mr. Sunil Rewachand Chandiramani (Independent Director), Mrs. Sangeeta Sumesh (Independent Director), Mr. Amitabh Jaipuria (Non-executive Director from May 01, 2023 till Mar 31, 2026).
